title.en: Eight-Inch Chiffon Cake with Strawberry Cream

summary.zh: 8 寸 · 270°F 烤 60 分钟 · 草莓奶油夹馅或抹面
summary.en: 8-inch · bake at 270°F for 60 minutes · strawberry cream filling or frosting

steps.zh: 牛奶与油先混合。原记录列有面粉、玉米淀粉、鸡蛋、少许盐、糖和少许柠檬汁。
steps.en: Mix the milk and oil first. The original note lists flour, cornstarch, eggs, a pinch of salt, sugar, and a little lemon juice.

steps.zh: 草莓奶油按淡奶油、草莓酱和奶油奶酪的记录比例准备。
steps.en: Prepare the strawberry cream using the recorded proportions of heavy cream, strawberry jam, and cream cheese.

notes.zh: 低筋面粉原记 70 g，后改为 65 g，最终确认使用 60 g；原记 300°F，最终确认使用 270°F。原记录没有写明分蛋、打发、翻拌、模具与脱模的具体做法，也没有说明草莓奶油是夹馅还是抹面。
notes.en: Cake flour was first recorded as 70 g, then changed to 65 g, and finally confirmed at 60 g. The original temperature was 300°F and was finally confirmed at 270°F. The note does not specify separating the eggs, whipping, folding, the pan, or unmolding, nor whether the strawberry cream is a filling or frosting.

notes.zh: 手写页底另有蛋白用量的计算草稿，含义不够明确，暂不作为本配方用量。
notes.en: There is also a calculation draft for egg-white amounts at the bottom of the handwritten page. Its meaning is unclear, so it is not treated as an ingredient quantity.
